title: Ceiling Fan — one Math Engine, down rod, hub and pitched blades
description:
A parametric CEILING FAN on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE and it hangs at that point from the ceiling height you set. Rotation spins the blade set about the down rod, which on a fan is a real setting rather than a placement detail.

BLADE PITCH IS STEPPED, NOT FAKED. A quad prism is flat between one z0 and one z1, so a twisted blade cannot be a single quad. The blade is therefore cut into N CHORDWISE STRIPS, each a flat quad at its own elevation `_zm = base + f·chord·tan(pitch)` — a staircase approximation of the twist that converges as the step count rises, and collapses to a flat blade at 1 step. This is stated rather than hidden: at 4 steps it reads as a pitched blade; it is not an aerofoil.

BLADES AND STRIPS ARE ONE BROADCAST. `kron(arange(blades), ones(steps,1))` gives every strip its blade angle and `kron(ones(blades,1), arange(steps))` its chord position, so a 3-blade and a 10-blade fan are the same seven lines. Each strip's four corners are the radial direction `(cos θ, sin θ)` and its perpendicular, combined with the strip's chord offsets — which is why a ROTATED blade needs no special case anywhere: the quad kernel takes arbitrary corners.

THE ROOT IS NARROWER THAN THE TIP by `bladeTaper`, applied only to the two hub-end corners, so the blade is a trapezoid — again free, because the kernel never assumed a rectangle.

THE LIGHT KIT IS A REVOLVE, NOT A SPHERE. A Sphere row is DIMENSIONED — its size lives in fields on the row that no wire can reach — so a computed dome has to be `mlathe`: a quarter-circle profile swept about the fan axis, which is parametric and renders down the same Polyhedron path.

THE PLAN IS A DRAFTING SYMBOL, which is what a plan wants: the swept circle at blade-tip radius, the blades over it, and the hub as a dot. All three are the same numbers the model is built from.

SOLIDITY is the ratio of blade area to swept area — the number that actually characterises a fan — and it comes free from dimensions already present.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: a 1.42 m sweep on four 0.62 m blades at 12°, blades at 2.36 m, 1.58 m² swept, solidity 0.186, clear headroom 2.22 m.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Blades are flat plates with a stepped twist — no camber, no rake, no curved planform. The fan does not turn: there is no motion, only a rotation setting.

params.name: Ceiling Fan maths
params.expr:
_natL = 2 * (hubRadius + bladeLength)
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_nb = max(2, round(blades))
_bL = bladeLength * _s
_ch = bladeChord * _s
_bT = bladeThk * _s
_hubR = hubRadius * _s
_hubH = hubHeight * _s
_rodL = rodLength * _s
_rodR = rodRadius * _s
_ceil = ceilingHeight * _s
_ltR = lightRadius * _s
_hubTop = _ceil - _rodL
_hubBot = _hubTop - _hubH
_bladeZ = _hubBot + _hubH / 2
_span = 2 * (_hubR + _bL)
_bodyL = _span
_bodyW = _span
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Blades — every blade and every pitch step in ONE broadcast (kron pair, as in the curtain).
# A blade is a quad from hub to tip; the pitch is expressed as N chordwise strips, each a flat
# quad at its own elevation, so the twist is stepped rather than faked.
_nst = max(1, round(pitchSteps))
_bi = kron(arange(_nb), ones(_nst, 1))
_sj = kron(ones(_nb, 1), arange(_nst))
_th = _bi * 2 * PI / _nb
_cth = cos(_th)
_sth = sin(_th)
_r0 = fill(rows(_bi), 1, _hubR * 0.9)
_r1 = _r0 + _bL
_f0 = _sj / _nst - 0.5
_f1 = (_sj + 1) / _nst - 0.5
_tp = tan(pitch * PI / 180)
_c0 = _f0 * _ch
_c1 = _f1 * _ch
_tap = max(0.05, bladeTaper)
_x1 = _r0 * _cth - _c0 * _tap * _sth
_y1 = _r0 * _sth + _c0 * _tap * _cth
_x2 = _r1 * _cth - _c0 * _sth
_y2 = _r1 * _sth + _c0 * _cth
_x3 = _r1 * _cth - _c1 * _sth
_y3 = _r1 * _sth + _c1 * _cth
_x4 = _r0 * _cth - _c1 * _tap * _sth
_y4 = _r0 * _sth + _c1 * _tap * _cth
_zm = _bladeZ + (_f0 + _f1) / 2 * _ch * _tp
Q = hcat(_x1, _y1, _x2, _y2, _x3, _y3, _x4, _y4, _zm - _bT / 2, _zm + _bT / 2, fill(rows(_bi),1,1))
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Blades3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
BladesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Down rod, canopy and hub — vertical axis segments for Tube rows
_ROD = hcat(0, 0, _hubTop, 0, 0, _ceil, _rodR)
_CAN = hcat(0, 0, _ceil - 0.05 * _s, 0, 0, _ceil, _hubR * 0.7)
_HUB = hcat(0, 0, _hubBot, 0, 0, _hubTop, _hubR)
_t1u = _cu + col(_ROD,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(_ROD,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(_ROD,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(_ROD,4)
Rod3D = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(_ROD,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(_ROD,5), col(_ROD,6))
_t1u = _cu + col(_CAN,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(_CAN,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(_CAN,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(_CAN,4)
Canopy3D = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(_CAN,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(_CAN,5), col(_CAN,6))
_t1u = _cu + col(_HUB,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(_HUB,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(_HUB,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(_HUB,4)
Hub3D = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(_HUB,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(_HUB,5), col(_HUB,6))
_wcx = _cu * _ux + _cv * _vx
_wcy = _cu * _uy + _cv * _vy
# Light kit — a revolved dome, because a Sphere row is DIMENSIONED and no wire can drive it
_nls = 12
_lk = arange(_nls) + 1
_lth = PI / 2 * _lk / _nls
_lt = _ltR * 0.85 * (1 - cos(_lth))
_lr = _ltR * sin(_lth)
_lprof = vcat(hcat(0, 0), hcat(_lt, _lr), hcat(_ltR * 0.85, 0))
_lseg = hcat(_wcx, _wcy, _hubBot, _wcx, _wcy, _hubBot - 1)
_LKr = mlathe(_lseg, _lprof, 24)
Light3D = lightKit > 0 ? _LKr : zeros(0, 4)
# Plan symbol — the hub as a circle with its own radius in the third column
HubPlan = hcat(_wcx, _wcy, _hubR)
SweepPlan = hcat(_wcx, _wcy, _hubR + _bL)
# Metrics
sweepDiameter = _span
bladeCount = _nb
bladeSpan = _bL
sweptArea = PI * (_hubR + _bL) * (_hubR + _bL)
bladeArea = _nb * _bL * _ch * (1 + _tap) / 2
solidity = sweptArea > 0 ? bladeArea / sweptArea : 0
bladeElevation = _bladeZ
hangDown = _ceil - (lightKit > 0 ? (_hubBot - _ltR * 0.85) : _hubBot)
clearHeadroom = lightKit > 0 ? (_hubBot - _ltR * 0.85) : _hubBot
